steps.title: Research caption extraction and timestamp estimation
steps.description: Read all reference files thoroughly (especially demo-video-pipeline-spec-v2.md and the 3 pipeline scripts). Research how to generically extract showCaption()/caption() calls from any Playwright spec file and estimate their video timestamps by tracing waitForTimeout chains. Evaluate AST parsing (ts-morph or @babel/parser) vs regex extraction. Prototype the extraction on highlights-with-captions.spec.ts. Document findings and chosen approach. Also research auto-discover mode: how to read a project's routes, components, and data-testid attributes to generate a demo spec automatically.

steps.title: Build SKILL.md and pipeline scripts
steps.description: Use the claude-skill-creator skill to build .claude/skills/playwright-demo/SKILL.md with proper frontmatter. Create the pipeline scripts: (1) extract-captions.mjs, (2) generate-voice.mjs, (3) merge-video.mjs, (4) add-music.mjs, (5) run-pipeline.mjs. Create templates directory with: caption overlay, demo helpers, playwright video recording config.

steps.title: Integration test against harness-v2-test
steps.description: Test the full pipeline end-to-end against harness-v2-test. Run caption extraction, TTS generation (cached), freeze-frame merge, music overlay. Verify final MP4.

steps.title: Polish and iterate on auto-discover mode
steps.description: Test auto-discover mode against harness-v2-test. Verify discovery logic detects framework, routes, features. Compare auto-generated spec to manual. Test guided mode. Final pipeline validation.
